text:
devon: Heads-up — we just got a customer escalation (CS-2389). Multiple 504s across a tenant during a traffic spike around 10:02 UTC.
maria: saw alerts too, gateway latency spiked then. Logs show model pods stuck in Init.
ajay: any relation to the new keda/pod-template we shipped yesterday?
luis: looking at k8s events now. Getting readiness probe timeouts on model pods, repeated 10s probe failure.
sre-oncall: repro steps from customer: burst of ~1200 req/min, then ~30% 504s for ~3m. They hit our hosted inference API: `POST /v1/generate` -> 504.
maria: pasted proxy trace: `upstream timeout after 60s` and model pod CPU=0 consistently even while pending Ready.
ajay: share scaledobject config? might be annotation mismatch between HPA target and KEDA metric.
luis: snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  annotations:
    autoscaling.alpha.kubernetes.io/behavior: "{\"scaleDown\":{\"stabilizationWindowSeconds\":300}}"
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: model-pool
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://prom:9090
      metricName: requests_per_second
      threshold: "100"
```
maria: ah — the HPA minReplicas is still 0 in the helm values, KEDA tries to scale but our warm-start hooks require init container run that blocks before Ready. If minReplica=0, coldstart can be slow.
devon: that lines up. Customer reports long model initialization (model fetch + quant load ~35s). When autoscaler scales from 0 -> N, readiness doesn't pass quickly and gateway times out.
sre-oncall: timeline: scale event at 10:01:45, pods scheduled, init starts, readiness fails until 10:02:20, ingress timed out at 10:02:45 -> 504 spikes.
ajay: patch idea: set minReplicas=1 for this tenant pool, or use KEDA `activation` to pre-warm based on queue length.
luis: also noticed `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` but image was updated last week; slow image pulls contributed on some nodes.
maria: reproduction steps I ran in staging: `kubectl scale deploy/model-pool --replicas=0`, then flood with `hey -n 2000 -c 100 http://staging.redwood/v1/generate`. Observed identical 504s and pods stuck in `Init:CreateVolume`.
ajay: paste of kube events during repro: ```
Warning  FailedMount  7s (x3)  kubelet, node-12  MountVolume.MountDevice failed for volume "model-cache" : rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
```
maria: so two contributing factors: mount delays + zero-min autoscaling. Combined cause scale-up lag beyond gateway timeout.
devon: immediate mitigation for prod: 1) set minReplicas=1 for affected tenant pools, 2) bump ingress timeout to 90s for affected route as temporary, 3) open support ticket and advise customer.
sre-oncall: I'm pushing a canary to set minReplicas=1 for tenant-42 via kustomize now. Will monitor.
luis: long-term: we should add a prewarm policy in onboarding to recommend non-zero min for tenants with heavy cold-init. Also investigate CSI driver timeouts for the model cache mounts.
ajay: I'll open an RFC to add a `preferredWarmReplicas` field surfaced in the Console with recommendation engine from Optimize.
maria: support-bot: created support case CS-2389, notified customer, added runbook link: <https://redwood-internal/support/runbooks/scaleup-warmstart>.
sre-oncall: canary applied at 10:15 UTC. Initial telemetry: error rate dropped to baseline within 2m. :thumbsup:
devon: great — assign follow-ups: luís -> investigate CSI timeouts and image pull slowness; ajay -> RFC for console recommendation; maria -> update onboarding docs + send email to customer with mitigations.
luis: grabbing logs for CSI driver and node kubelet. Posting findings in the incident doc.
ajay: adding a short-term tweak: add KEDA scaledobject `pollingInterval` lower to detect ramp earlier for bursty tenants.
maria: note for SRE: consider increasing readinessProbe timeout during init stage so we aren't flapping readiness while init tasks still running.
sre-oncall: logging final state: last 30m after canary shows average latency stable, 504 count returned to 0 for tenant. Will keep monitoring for 2 hours.
devon: thanks team. I'll create postmortem with timeline and action items once follow-ups complete.
support-bot: incident CS-2389 updated: status -> mitigated, severity -> SEV3, linked playbook.
keda-bot: auto-detection: ScaledObject `model-pool` shows activationThreshold not set; recommend setting `activationThreshold: "10"` for queue-based triggers.
maria: closing thread for now, reopen if spike recurs. :eyes:
